title: Business Development Associate
description:
Sales / Business Development Intern — DemandPay

**Location:** Bengaluru | On-site  
**Openings:** 2  
**Stipend:** ₹15,000/month + performance incentives  
**Earning potential:** ₹18,000–₹25,000+ per month for strong performers

About DemandPay

DemandPay is a B2B Fintech company building intelligent payment collection and Accounts Receivable infrastructure for businesses.

Our vision is:

**A world where every invoice is paid on time — automatically.**

Our mission is to ensure that **no one has to waste time chasing money again.**

We help businesses automate customer follow-ups, payment collection, reconciliation and receivables management.

DemandPay sells to businesses **across India**, including ISPs, broadband operators, distributors, manufacturers and enterprises managing recurring or high-volume collections.

We are also building the **DemandPay AI Accounts Receivable Agent** — an autonomous AR employee designed to track outstanding invoices, follow up with customers, understand responses, schedule the next action and escalate exceptions automatically.

Our core sales team includes professionals with experience at **PhonePe and Cashfree**.

We are now looking for **2 ambitious Sales / Business Development Interns** to join our Bengaluru sales team.

What You’ll Do

Prospecting

Research and identify potential customers across India and build high-quality prospect lists.

Outbound Sales

Make **60–80 focused outbound calls every day** to business owners, decision-makers and potential customers.

Qualification

Understand the prospect's business, identify their collection/payment problems and determine whether there is a genuine opportunity for DemandPay.

Demo Generation

Book qualified discovery calls and product demonstrations for the senior sales team.

Follow-ups

Maintain disciplined follow-ups with prospects and ensure opportunities continue progressing through the sales pipeline.

CRM & Pipeline Management

Keep prospect information, conversations, follow-up dates and opportunities updated in the CRM.

Learn B2B Fintech Sales

Work directly with experienced sales professionals and learn how real B2B Fintech and SaaS deals are prospected, pitched, negotiated and closed.

Who We're Looking For

You may be a strong fit if:

* You are comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with people you have never met.
* You are willing to make **60–80 prospect conversations/calls per day**.
* Rejection does not affect your motivation.
* You are competitive and target-driven.
* You communicate clearly and confidently.
* You learn quickly and respond well to feedback.
* You are disciplined with follow-ups.
* You genuinely want to build a career in **B2B Sales, SaaS or Fintech**.

This role is **not designed for someone looking only for an internship certificate or observational experience**.

You will learn sales by actually selling.

Language Requirements

**Required:** English + Hindi

Knowledge of **Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali or other Indian regional languages** will be an advantage.

Compensation

**Fixed stipend:** ₹15,000- ₹20000

Strong performers can earn approximately **₹18,000–₹25,000+ per month** through performance incentives.

Career Opportunity

This internship can become a fast-track entry into DemandPay's sales organization.

High-performing interns will be considered for full-time roles such as:

* Business Development Representative (BDR)
* Sales Executive
* Account Executive

Your progression will be based primarily on **performance, learning ability and sales results**.

What You'll Get

* Real B2B Fintech sales exposure
* Hands-on outbound prospecting experience
* Direct experience speaking with businesses across India
* Training from experienced sales professionals
* Exposure to CRM and structured pipeline management
* Experience booking and progressing real sales opportunities
* Opportunity to move quickly into a full-time sales role

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
fit_rationale: Target role fit: 98/100. Focus: B2B sales & outbound pipeline alignment (Pencil Mark / AERO India), AI data annotation & evaluation alignment (Instawork AI Data).

**Job Description**

Responsibilities: Customs & Documentation Specialist

*Process Associate / Senior Process Associate – Bangalore*

Main Job Purpose

The Customs & Documentation Specialist is responsible for the end-to-end preparation of customs declarations and export/shipment documentation, ensuring smooth, compliant, and audit-proof movement of goods. The role combines customs declaration management (UK & DE export declarations, transit documents, supplementary declarations) with shipping documentation responsibilities (collection, sharing, and storage of export documents), acting as the single point of contact for customs- and documentation-related issues across factories, logistics, planning, procurement, dispatch, and sourcing teams.

Key Responsibilities

Customs Declarations

* Prepare and file UK & DE export declarations.
* Prepare and file transit documents for UK exports.
* Prepare and file Supplementary Declarations for UK imports.
* Monitor shipment progress and resolve any customs documentation issues that arise.
* Control proofs of exit and liaise directly with Customs Authorities.
* Manage and control customs declarations from a legal and compliance perspective (audit-proof).
* Act as first point of contact (FPOC) for any customs-related issues for factories, logistics, planning, procurement, and customs teams.
* Perform data quality checks on all submitted declarations.

Shipping & Export Documentation

* Collect and prepare all shipping documentation for the movement of products from Supply Units to destination markets.
* Share digital and paper documents with clients in a timely manner.
* Ensure documents are ready and accurate ahead of shipment deadlines.
* Ensure secure storage of documentation and its availability for audits.
* Ensure correct priority is given to transport based on customer service needs.
* Carry out ad-hoc activities related to customs and documentation processes.
* Work in close cooperation with the Dispatch team, Sourcing Units, Ultra Logistics team, and Customs.

Shift & Coverage (entry-level roles)

* 24/7 shift working pattern.
* Stand-by duty during post-working hours (nights and weekends), as required by role level.

Minimum Qualifications

* Experience in customs, foreign trade, logistics, finance, planning, or procurement.
* Strong Excel skills.
* Basic to working knowledge of customs processes.
* Good communication in English – both oral and written; able to communicate effectively with all levels of management and peers.
* Organizational awareness and good skills in planning own workload.
* University degree (minimum Bachelor).
* For senior / bilingual roles: an additional European language (e.g., German) at a professional working level.

Preferred Qualifications / Skills

* Knowledge of SAP & SAP GTS – an advantage.
* Self-motivated and independent personality with strong problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of supply chain and supply planning business drivers.
* Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work under time pressure and quickly set priorities.
* Another European language is an asset.
* Experience in supply planning or logistics is an asset.
* Advanced MS Excel.
* For Team Leader track: minimum 2 years' experience in team management.

**Qualifications**

Bachelors - Business Administration, Bachelors - Industrial Engineering, Bachelors - Logistics, Bachelors - Supply Chain Management, Masters - Operations Management
